name: Universal Logistics / LINC - Romulus Value-Added Center - Romulus MI

fieldNotes.facility: Universal Logistics / Logistics Insight Corp (LINC) cross-dock and value-added logistics campus at 29129 Ecorse Rd, Romulus MI (Wayne County, near Detroit Metro Airport). A sprawling multi-building terminal: several long narrow cross-dock buildings (dock doors on both long faces) plus extensive trailer-storage yards. Street View shows the yard packed with XPO Logistics-, LINC Logistics- and Universal-branded trailers — operates as a multi-tenant/3PL cross-dock terminal. Confirmed via Yellow Pages, Waze, Universal Logistics hiring posts (incl. a 'Gate Clerk' role at this address).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole campus is fenced — 2025 Street View confirms continuous chain-link perimeter fence along the full Ecorse Rd frontage with trailers parked behind it. Truck access is through a single wide controlled opening in the fence off Ecorse Rd, with jersey-barrier lane control at the gap and a canopy/structure near the entrance drive. A Universal 'Gate Clerk' job posting at this address implies a gate-check function.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth (1-3 vehicle footprint) cleanly resolves at the entrance opening, though a small canopy structure sits along the entry drive. Access control most likely a gate-clerk kiosk / check-in point rather than a classic shack -> remoteGs true. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple long narrow cross-dock buildings, each with continuous dock-door banks on BOTH long faces and trailers backed in along them -> a very high total, estimated ~200+ doors -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: The entire campus functions as a drop yard — hundreds of trailers parked in marked rows across multiple lots, including a large gravel trailer-storage yard south of the drainage ditch -> 50+ band; dropYard true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building campus: ~6 distinct cross-dock/warehouse buildings plus separate satellite trailer yards.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock buildings load and unload from both faces of the same building; not a separated ship-vs-receive bank layout -> false.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance opening and very large open yard apron leave ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial setting in Romulus — bordered by light residential and open/vacant land, near Detroit Metro Airport; per the rubric's small-town-vs-urban tie-breaker, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property -> false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~95 acres for the fenced campus including the southern gravel trailer yard.
